newsitem.title: FRANCE: BoF to monitor narrow and broad money aggregates.
newsitem.headline: BoF to monitor narrow and broad money aggregates.

text.p: Bank of France Governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday the monetary policy council had decided to monitor several narrow and broad money aggregates simultaneously to get a clear picture of monetary developments.

Speaking at the Bank of France's annual news conference, Trichet said data, particularly broadbased M3 figures, had been badly disrupted recently by several factors such as a big fall in short-term rates and the ensuing large-scale reaollocation of investment flows towards non-monetary assets.
Higher taxes on money market mutual funds and the continuing high levels of interest paid on housing savings plans had also disturbed M3 data.

"We will therefore keep a very close eye on the M1, M2, M3 and M3 plus P1 aggregates as expressions of the underlying growth of the money supply," he said. "Particular attention will be paid to the growth of the M3 plus P1 aggregate covering monetary assets and contractual savings."
